            a1 = ThreePointArc(l1 @ 1, (handle_length/2, -handle_width/2 + corner_radius), (handle_length/2, 0))
            a2 = ThreePointArc(a1 @ 1, (handle_length/2, handle_width/2 - corner_radius), (handle_length/2 - corner_radius, handle_width/2))
            l2 = Line(a2 @ 1, (-handle_length/2 + corner_radius, handle_width/2))
            a3 = ThreePointArc(l2 @ 1, (-handle_length/2, handle_width/2 - corner_radius), (-handle_length/2, 0))
            a4 = ThreePointArc(a3 @ 1, (-handle_length/2, -handle_width/2 + corner_radius), (-handle_length/2 + corner_radius, -handle_width/2))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=handle_height)
